input_condition: 1st Sample: before food. 2nd Sample: 2 hours after a meal or stimulant.
preferred first because strict fasting (water only); Vitals normal.
tests: Lipid Profile (Total, HDL, LDL, VLDL, Triglycerides)
Iron Profile (Iron, TIBC, Transferrin Saturation, Ferritin)
All Drug Screens (Cocaine, Morphine, THC, etc.)
24-hr Heavy Metal Analysis (Lead, Mercury, Zinc, etc.)

input_condition: TMT Preferred last; Vitals at rest for ECG/Echo/PFT.
output_effect: TMT: Heartbeat and BP increase. PFT: Temporary breathlessness.

tests: CSF Tests: Routine, Glucose, Protein, ADA, Viral antibodies, Beta HCG, TPHA
Body Fluid Tests: Amylase, Bilirubin, Cholesterol, Creatinine, Electrolytes, LDH, PTH, Phosphorus, Protein, Urea, Uric Acid, Thyroglobulin
Swabs/Cultures: Pyogenic/Aerobic/Anaerobic Cultures, High Vaginal Swab, Throat Swab, Sputum (AFB Culture/Stain), Albert/Gram/ZN Stains, OT Surveillance
Genetic/NGS: WGS, WES, BRCA1&2, NIPT, HLA Typing, Karyotyping, FISH Panels, JAK2, FLT3, NPM1, CFTR, SMA, DMD, PMP22, Fragile X
Allergy: Food/Inhalant/Dust Panels, Specific IgE (Egg, Milk, Peanut, Shrimp, etc.)
Infectious Disease: HIV, HCV, HBV, Dengue, Malaria, Typhoid, TB, COVID-19 PCR, TORCH, Viral Panels
Immunity/Autoimmune: ANA 25, Anti-dsDNA, Rheumatoid Factor, CRP, ESR, ASLO, Complement C3/C4, Myositis Profile, SLE Panel, Anti-CCP
Vitamins/Hormones: Vit B12, D, B Complex, C, Folate, TSH, T3, T4, Cortisol, Testosterone, Prolactin, AMH, FSH, LH, Insulin
Tumor Markers: CA-125, PSA, CEA, AFP, CA-19-9, HE4, NSE
TDM: Lithium, Valproic acid, Tacrolimus, Digoxin, Dilantin, Cyclosporine
Routine: CBC/Haemogram, LFT, KFT/RFT, Uric Acid, Creatinine, Electrolytes, CPK, Troponin I/T, BNP, Blood Group
